purpose: Verify that the B1 forward/label/normalization/loss/optimizer chain can fit four fixed formal-train cases.
case_selection: For each of fast and slow, select the minimum and maximum peak-WSS case mean from dev1 formal train. Once locked_cases.json is written, replacement is forbidden.
checkpoint_rule: Use the last epoch only; validation selection and early stopping are disabled.
stop_rule: GO only if both thresholds pass. Otherwise report NO_GO and do not launch LC or sweeps; numerical debugging requires a separately recorded minimal change.
